reference.question: A slope has a vertical height of 6 m and a horizontal width of 8 m. Write its slope ratio in the form \(1:m\) and find \(m\). (Express the result as a fraction in lowest terms.)
reference.solution:
Method 1: Normalize the slope ratio

The slope ratio is \(6:8=1:(8/6)=1:(4/3)\), so \(m=4/3\).
